title: Why Trading Crypto Can Be More Rewarding Than Simply Holding
author: Outrageous-Hat9277
selftext:
Most people in crypto are focused on holding and hoping the market moves in their favor. While holding can be profitable during strong bull runs, active trading gives you the opportunity to generate returns in both rising and falling markets.  
A trader doesn't have to wait months or years for a single asset to appreciate. By understanding market trends, risk management, and proper entry and exit points, it's possible to take advantage of short-term price movements and compound profits over time.  
Holding leaves your capital dependent on one direction. Trading allows you to put your assets to work adapt to changing market conditions, and create multiple profit opportunities throughout the year.  
The goal is not just to own crypto it's to make your crypto work for you.
